subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: Should CodexBar permanently ship and maintain `AdaptiveReplayCLI` after it is refactored to use the canonical production policy?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds a new package product and meaningful maintenance surface, which VISION.md reserves for explicit sign-off rather than automated acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor shared-policy CLI
options.body: Approve the executable after replay and the app are refactored to call one canonical pure adaptive policy.

options.title: Keep replay external
options.body: Decline the permanent package product and use external replay evidence to support narrower production-policy proposals.

recommendation.title: Keep replay external
recommendation.body: Decline the permanent package product and use external replay evidence to support narrower production-policy proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner reviewed and merged both the adaptive decision record and its production implementation.
